newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ABSA hikes prime to 20.25 pct from Nov 22.
newsitem.headline: ABSA hikes prime to 20.25 pct from Nov 22.

text.p: Amalgamated Banks of South Africa Ltd said on Thursday it was increasing its prime lending rate to 20.25 percent from 19.25 percent, effective November 22.

A spokesman said the bank would also lift its home loan rate one percentage point to 20.00 percent. The new rate would be effective from November 22 for new bonds, while existing bonds would be charged the new rate from December 1.
Absa's move follows the Reserve Bank's announcement on Wednesday night that it would hike Bank rate by one percentage point to 17 percent from Thursday.
Standard Bank was the first to move, announcing a one point hike with immediate effect.
